newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares close up despite Novo, Tele Dk falls.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares close up despite Novo, Tele Dk falls.

text.p: Danish share prices closed higher in a generally positive market on Wednesday despite falls in key blue chips Novo Nordisk and Tele Danmark, with dealers seeing a wary mood ahead.
Friday - Great Prayer Day - is a national holiday in Denmark and markets are closed, hence traders' caution.

"The market was optimistic despite a lack of buyer interest in Tele Danmark and a Pharmacia & Upjohn first quarter 1997 profit warning on Novo, factors causing these shares to fall and inhibit greater index rises," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index ended the day 1.05 point up at 155.79.
Overall bourse turnover was 916 million crowns. The KFX June future rose 1.70 point to 154.90 with 140 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
Tele Danmark closed five crowns lower at 330, while Novo Nordisk finished four down at 665, having tumbled from a high of 680.
